description: Newlines inside an attribute splat are ignored inside an interpolation
notes: The spec says newlines are ignored inside parentheses, brackets, braces and function call arguments, but doesn't say so for interpolation sequences, and it describes a quoted template as a single-line expression. hashicorp/hcl ignores newlines inside interpolations: parseTemplateParts in hclsyntax/parser_template.go calls PushIncludeNewlines(false) before parsing the expression.
